title: Tea Country Sri Lanka: Hatton and Kandy Bungalow Stay
alt: Tea pickers on the terraced hills above Hatton
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Hatton
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Bungalow room · 3★ · Planters bungalow among the tea estates above Hatton

activities.name: Devon and St Clair waterfalls
activities.description: The twin falls of the Hatton valley seen from the road, with a short trek down to the pools at the base.

activities.name: Tea factory visit and tasting
activities.description: A tour of a working factory from withering to rolling and firing, finishing with a tasting of the grades.

activities.name: Spice garden visit
activities.description: A walk through a hillside spice garden to see cinnamon, pepper, cardamom and vanilla growing.

program.name: Hatton
program.description: Two nights in a planters bungalow with waterfalls, a trek and a working tea factory on the first day and the spice garden on the second.

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Bungalow room · 3★ · Hillside bungalow with views over the Kandy valley

activities.name: Kandy city walk and markets
activities.description: A day on foot around the lake, the bazaars and the craft shops of the old royal capital.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights above the hill capital with a scenic transfer through the plantations, a free day in the city and the markets.

day_titles.1: Arrival and the waterfalls of Hatton
day_titles.2: Tea hills and the spice garden

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer into the hills
Devon Falls and St Clair Falls from the estate road
A trek down to the pools at the base of the falls
A tea factory tour and tasting before check in
2: A morning among the tea terraces around Hatton
The spice garden and its cinnamon and pepper vines
An evening at the bungalow with the mist coming in
3: Breakfast and check out of the bungalow
A scenic transfer through the estates to Kandy
Check in at your hillside bungalow above the town
Optional: the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic at evening puja
4: Breakfast, then the whole day yours in the city
The lake, the bazaars and the craft shops
Optional: the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
Optional: a Kandyan dance show in the evening
5: Optional: an early start for the Adams Peak pilgrim path
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Five slow days in the hills: two nights in a planters bungalow at Hatton with waterfalls, a tea factory and a spice garden, then two in a bungalow above Kandy with a free day in the old royal capital.
included: Included: 4 nights in hill country bungalows with breakfast; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Devon and St Clair waterfalls with a short trek; a tea factory tour and tasting; a spice garden visit; a scenic transfer through the plantations to Kandy.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
